{{Quote|Face it, Kir Kanos--in The Squall, I ''always'' win.''"<br />"''It's a big galaxy, Carnor Jax. The Squall exists only here on Yinchorr.|Carnor Jax and Kir Kanos|<ref name="ce 1" />}}
'''The Squall'''<ref name="ce 6">[[Crimson Empire 6|''Crimson Empire'' 6]]</ref> was an arena located at the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]] on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] where those aspiring to be members of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] battled each other for supremacy and favor of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] once [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Burr Danid]] in The Squall, reminding the trainees of how much they had yet to learn.<ref name="ce 1" /> 

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Kir Kanos]] met [[Carnor Jax]] in The Squall for their [[Duel in The Squall|final showdown]], where Kanos killed Jax by impaling him through the heart; Kanos left Jax's corpse lying on the center of The Squall, denying him the dignity Jax had denied so many other Royal Guards.<ref name="ce 6" />
